items.h: First career TD in Week 10 loss
items.s: Sturdivant caught two passes for 37 yards and a touchdown on four targets in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings. After Green Bay was shut out in the first half, Sturdivant's first career touchdown came in the third quarter from 32 yards out, and it went down as the Packers' lone touchdown of the afternoon. Sturdivant played just nine offensive snaps as the fourth receiver and would need more than one injury ahead of him on the depth chart to be relevant in fantasy.

items.h: J. Michael Sturdivant catches touchdown in Week 10 loss
items.s: J. Michael Sturdivant caught two of his four targets for 37 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10. Sturdivant saw an uptick in usage Sunday, logging more than one target for the first time in his last seven contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats until further notice ahead of the team's Week 11 bye.

items.h: Records first catches of NFL career
items.s: Sturdivant tallied three catches on as many targets for 22 yards during the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday. Sturdivant's nine-yard catch late in the third quarter was the first of his NFL career. He went on to haul in two more passes of three and 10 yards in the fourth quarter and finished Thursday's contest having played 21 of the Packers' 66 snaps on offense (31.8 percent). Most of that playing time came when Green Bay was facing a large deficit, but Sturdivant figures to see at least some involvement in the offense given the uncertainty around the status of Jayden Reed (neck) for the rest of the 2026 season.

Sturdivant (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Vikings. The undrafted rookie out of Florida impressed the Packers' coaching staff enough to crack the 53-man roster at the end of training camp, but he'll have to wait until Week 2 against the Jets on Sunday, Sept. 20, to make his regular-season debut. Bo Melton and Skyy Moore will be the depth wideouts for Sunday's NFC North clash behind Christian Watson, Jayden Reed and Matthew Golden.

Sturdivant has made Green Bay's initial 53-man roster, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports. The undrafted free agent out of Florida impressed the coaching staff with 112 receiving yards and a touchdown in the Packers' preseason finale. Sturdivant is likely to be limited to a depth role out of the gate, as Christian Watson, Jayden Reed and Matthew Golden seem secure in the top three spots on the wide receiver depth chart.

items.h: J. Michael Sturdivant Earns Spot on Packers' 53-Man Roster
items.s: Green Bay Packers wide receiver J. Michael Sturdivant has earned a spot on the team's initial 53-man roster, according to Rob Demovsky. The undrafted rookie made his biggest push at exactly the right time. Sturdivant caught six passes for 112 yards and a touchdown in Friday's preseason finale against Arizona, giving him nine receptions for a team-high 142 yards over three preseason games. Green Bay had several receivers fighting for the final spots, with Isaiah Neyor, Will Sheppard, Kisean Johnson and Kaden Prather among those released Sunday. items.h: Explodes for 112 yards in exhibition finale
items.s: Sturdivant caught six of seven targets for 112 yards and a touchdown Friday in a 42-38 preseason victory over Arizona. Sturdivant and QB Kyle McCord accounted for all of the yardage on the Packers' first touchdown drive, connecting on a 36-yard pass down the middle before Sturdivant hauled in a 29-yard touchdown along the sideline on the following play. Sturdivant had been in concussion protocol earlier in the week, but he recovered in time to play Friday and posted a huge performance in his effort to secure a spot on the 53-man roster. Even with Friday's impressive effort, the 23-year-old could end up being cut by the end of the weekend, though it wouldn't be surprising at all if…

items.h: J. Michael Sturdivant Posts 112 Yards, Score in Packers' Win
items.s: Green Bay Packers wide receiver J. Michael Sturdivant posted a quality receiving line for the Packers in their final preseason tune-up at Lambeau Field on Friday night, a 42-38 win over the Arizona Cardinals. While the Packers didn't play any player who is locked into the 53-man roster on offense besides maybe Bo Melton, J. Michael Sturdivant has been excellent when he's gotten on the field this preseason. An undrafted free agent from Florida, Sturdivant caught 6-of-7 passes from Kyle McCord and turned those six catches into 112 receiving yards and a 29-yard touchdown reception in the second quarter. Sturdivant (concussion) has yet to return to practice, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports. Sturdivant is competing for a spot on the Packers' initial 53-man roster, but he has been sidelined at practice after suffering a concussion. The undrafted wide receiver has appeared in both of the Packers' preseason contests so far, reeling in three of four targets for 30 yards. Sturdivant will have a couple more chances to clear protocol and return to practice before Friday's preseason finale against Arizona.

items.h: J. Michael Sturdivant signs with Packers as UDFA
items.s: The Packers signed Florida WR J. Michael Sturdivant as an undrafted free agent. Sturdivant flashed throughout his collegiate career early on at Florida. He also spent time at Cal and UCLA. He could add on a role on special teams at the next level.
